title: Magaalak exxak tan xongolo
intro: Yallih miracsentak yewqeh yan magaalal, dubuk yan num irol yewqeeh, qaago kee maabitinah farmo luk qalala. Ta habbalte rooci diggale imaan amotani asta akkele.
clues: Anu farmoytit yi magaala fan ruubaanam ubleh, takkay immay yi ummatta qaadik tan marah innah ken yeyyeeqeh.
Anu ken farmol aamineh, numma yi manoh addat tantabbem yot tammulleeh tan.
Anu inni ummattah seeco abe farmoytiitih ammirtimiyyay uli acwa essere.
Anu magaalak allal kude, sissikuk sabab keenih yableenim gabbatak.
Yi ummatta yol ugutteeh, anu qideh, takkay immay anu amotani salaam gee.
Yalli yok iyyem jannat cul, yi ummatta yoh tomcowweh tan kunnabnah sumaaqitam qaagita.
arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
